host_delta: Fold packet aggregation into the existing transient FIELD machine handoff: every packet reduces to exactly one of NOW / DELTA / RESIDUE / GATE / NEXT / ARCHIVE without becoming a queue, store, route, or authority source.
law: Packet egress is derived, never packet-authorized. GATE → NOW → RESIDUE → NEXT → DELTA → ARCHIVE. Only caller-supplied CURRENT/explicit selection context can create NOW. DELTA requires material change plus host-attested sufficient EVIDENCE; unwitnessed change is RESIDUE. Uppercase compatibility aliases and inert RETURN-to-CURRENT/replan semantics are preserved. STOP suppresses continuation; historical/superseded material remains ARCHIVE unless explicitly reactivated.

/index.html — route-local changed witness attests material DELTA with host-owned evidence
/control/FIELD_INDEX_CONTRACT.json — executable truth bound to packet egress law
/returns/FIELD_PACKET_EGRESS_REDUCER_2026-09-29.json — malformed duplicate tail removed and durable receipt reconstructed

no new route, dashboard, queue, store, planner, ontology, or canonical packet cache
verify: FIELD route adapter emits material route_touch DELTA with evidence.sufficient=true only from its owned manifest/local catch-up witness
correction: Merged authority hardening left runtime behind the contract: uppercase OBJECT/AUTHORITY/STATE_IN/DELTA/EVIDENCE/STATE_OUT/RESIDUE/WAITING/NEXT/STOP aliases were promised but not executable.
RETURN-to-CURRENT/replan-only prose is terminal re-entry, not NEXT.
Precomputed egress labels remain advisory only and cannot manufacture attention or continuation.
Canonical exists:false / material:false fields do not manufacture attention.
The prior receipt on master contained a duplicated trailing fragment after its JSON object; this reconstruction restores one valid durable record.
residue: The reducer classifies egress only; it does not choose priority or execute NEXT.
Evidence sufficiency is asserted by the owning adapter/host; the generic reducer does not infer domain proof.
No second packet aggregation surface is authorized.
stop: After exact-head green proof, treat this reducer seam as closed. Do not render another packet dashboard.
